'''1999 Tennessee State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Tennessee in 1999. [[Josh Koziura]] won it; he posted his winning Light deck as "the 1999 Tennessee State Championship winning light deck".<ref name="dt-124">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/124 Nashville Style Beatdown], DeckTech (Josh "Blue1138" Koziura, 15 August 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/124/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/124/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 1999 (before 15 August)
* '''Site:''' Tennessee
* '''Winner:''' [[Josh Koziura]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
